headline: Held a private executive session on the City Manager's performance check-in; no other votes were recorded.
summary: Members went into executive session to discuss the City Manager's performance. The minutes record only procedural votes.

City of Winooski

Winooski City Council - Special Meeting 
      Wednesday, September 2, 2026, at 6 PM 
              
Attend in person: Winooski City Hall (27 W Allen St) 
Attend online: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84364849328 
Attend by phone: 1 646 558 8656 
Webinar ID: 843 6484 9328 
 
Members Present: Mayor Thomas Renner; Councilor Elsie Goodrich; Councilor Al Turkos; and Councilor Eli 
Ogilvie 
 
Officers Present: Elaine Wang, City Manager 
  
Others Present: None 
 
I. Call to Order at 6:00 PM 
II. Pledge of Allegiance led by Mayor Thomas Renner 
III. Agenda Review 
IV. Public Comment 
V. Proposed Executive Session 
 
A. Executive Session Pursuant to 1 V.S.A §313 (3), the appointment or employment or evaluation of a public 
officer or employee (City Manager performance check in) 
 
Motion: Motion by Councilor Turkos seconded by Councilor Goodrich to enter into executive session at 
6:05 PM.  Voted and passed 3-0. 
 
Motion: Motion by Councilor Turkos seconded by Councilor Goodrich to exit executive session at 7:21 PM.  
Voted and passed 3-0. 
     
VI. Adjourn 
 
Motion:  Motion by Councilor Goodrich seconded by Councilor Turkos to adjourn at 7:21 PM. Voted and passed 
3-0. 
      
 
     Attest:   _________________________________ 
                 Jenny Willingham, City Clerk
